verdict.rationale: Aleph documents its own Aleph Agent updating reports and dashboards through Slack or natural-language chat. That is a different capability from an external agent building or updating forecasts or scenarios through a documented machine interface, and no public API spec was found (the OpenAPI probes all returned 404). Audit logs are mentioned only generically, with no evidence that agent-made forecast changes land in the same audit trail as human edits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can build or update a forecast or scenario through a documented machine interface, and the change lands in the same audit trail as a human edit
